newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dlr edges back over 67 US cents after RBNZ move.
newsitem.headline: NZ dlr edges back over 67 US cents after RBNZ move.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar edged back over US$0.6700 on Friday afternoon after the Reserve Bank of New Zealand said monetary conditions had become too easy for its desired policy line.

Within ten minutes of the bank's statement, the kiwi was trading at 0.6702/09, after spending much of the midsession under 67 figure following a prolonged sell-off on the back of larger-than-expected current account deficit data this morning.
The dollar's move helped bring the Monetary Conditions Index back towards the RBNZ's comfort limit at 775 points, and by 3.20 p.m. (0320 GMT) the MCI stood at nearly 769, off a low near 750.
